meta.title: How to Use Captain Calendar | Fishon.my
meta.description: Learn how to manage your charter calendar, block dates for offline bookings, maintenance, and keep your availability up to date on Fishon.my.

hero.title: How to Use Captain Calendar
hero.subtitle: Master your charter calendar to manage bookings, block dates for maintenance or offline bookings, and keep your availability accurate for anglers.

overview.title: Calendar Overview
overview.description: The Captain Calendar is your central hub for managing all bookings and availability. View your schedule at a glance, block dates when needed, and never miss a booking.

features.title: Multiple Views
features.description: Switch between Month, Week, Day, and Agenda views to see your schedule the way you prefer.

features.title: See All Bookings
features.description: View all confirmed, pending, and completed bookings in one place with color-coded status.

features.title: Block Dates Easily
features.description: Block dates for offline bookings, boat maintenance, personal leave, or any reason you need.

features.title: Charter Switching
features.description: If you have multiple charters, easily switch between them to manage each calendar separately.

interactions.title: Calendar Interactions
interactions.description: Learn how to navigate and interact with your calendar effectively.

list.title: Click on a Date
list.description: Click any date to view that day in detail or to quickly create a new block for that date.

list.title: New Booking Button
list.description: Use the '+ New Booking' button in the header to block dates. This opens the block modal.

list.title: Click on Events
list.description: Click on any booking or blocked date to see details. Bookings show angler info, blocked dates can be edited.

list.title: Navigate Months/Weeks
list.description: Use the arrow buttons to move forward or backward through your calendar.

list.title: Go to Today
list.description: Click the 'Today' button to quickly jump back to the current date.

list.title: Filter by Charter
list.description: Use the sidebar to switch between different charters if you manage more than one.

list.title: Toggle Cancelled Bookings
list.description: Show or hide cancelled/rejected bookings using the filter in the sidebar.

list.title: Color-Coded Status
list.description: Bookings are color-coded: Blue for confirmed, Yellow for pending, Green for completed, Gray for cancelled.

list.title: Blocked Dates Display
list.description: Blocked dates appear in gray with the reason shown. Click to edit or delete them.

steps.title: How to Block Dates
steps.subtitle: Follow these steps to block dates for offline bookings, maintenance, or personal unavailability.

list.title: Open Block Modal
list.description: Click the '+ New Booking' button in the calendar header, or click directly on the date you want to block. A modal dialog will appear.

visual.hint: Or click directly on any date in the calendar

list.title: Choose Block Type
list.description: Select whether to block the entire charter (all trips unavailable) or just a specific trip. Blocking a specific trip allows other trips to still be booked.

list.title: Select a Reason
list.description: Choose a reason from the dropdown. This helps you track why dates are blocked and appears on your calendar.

list.title: Set Date Range
list.description: Select the start date. Enable 'Multi-day' checkbox if you need to block multiple consecutive days, then select the end date.

list.title: Optional: Block Specific Time
list.description: By default, the entire day is blocked. Toggle 'Block specific time' to set start and end times for partial-day blocks (e.g., morning only).

list.title: Save Block
list.description: Click 'Block Dates' to save. The blocked period will appear on your calendar immediately and anglers won't be able to book during this time.

examples.title: Real-World Examples
examples.subtitle: See how to handle common scenarios when blocking dates on your calendar.

list.title: Customer Calls to Book Directly
list.scenario: A customer calls you on WhatsApp to book a Full Day trip on December 20th. You want to block this date so no one else can book.
list.calendarDisplay: 20 Dec - Offline Booking: Full Day Trip

list.title: Scheduled Boat Maintenance
list.scenario: Your boat needs engine service next week. The mechanic will come on December 15-17. You need to block these 3 days.

list.title: Bad Weather Expected
list.scenario: Weather forecast shows storms on December 22nd afternoon. You want to cancel the afternoon Half Day trip but keep the morning available.
list.calendarDisplay: 22 Dec PM - Weather: Half Day Trip

list.title: Personal Day Off
list.scenario: You're attending a family event on December 25th (Christmas) and won't be available for any trips.

list.title: Block Early
list.description: Block dates as soon as you know you'll be unavailable. This prevents last-minute booking conflicts and disappointed customers.

list.title: Use Offline Booking for Non-Platform Bookings
list.description: When you receive a booking outside Fishon (phone, WhatsApp), mark it as 'Offline Booking' and select the trip type. This helps track your full business.

list.title: Check Calendar Regularly
list.description: Make it a habit to check your calendar daily or weekly. This helps you stay on top of bookings and avoid scheduling issues.

list.title: Use Multiple Views
list.description: Month view gives you the big picture, Week view helps with detailed planning, Day view shows time slots clearly, and Agenda view lists upcoming events.

list.title: Edit or Delete Blocks
list.description: Made a mistake? Click on any blocked date to edit the details or delete it entirely. Changes take effect immediately.

list.title: Block for Maintenance
list.description: Schedule regular boat maintenance and block those dates in advance. Keeping your boat in top shape means happy customers and great reviews.

cta.subtitle: Keep your availability up to date and never miss a booking opportunity.

hero.title: How to Register Your Charter
hero.subtitle: A complete step-by-step guide to listing your charter on Fishon.my and start receiving bookings from anglers across Malaysia.

overview.title: Registration Overview
overview.description: Registering your charter on Fishon.my is a simple 8-step process. Our wizard guides you through each step with auto-save, so you can complete it at your own pace.

features.title: Auto-Save
features.description: Your progress is automatically saved. Continue anytime without losing data.

features.title: Live Preview
features.description: See how your listing will appear to anglers before publishing.

features.title: Easy Media Upload
features.description: Upload photos and videos to showcase your charter and boat.

list.title: Basic Information
list.description: Enter your charter name, type (inshore, offshore, freshwater), and a compelling description. Add your location including city, state, and pickup point.

list.title: Boat Details
list.description: Provide your boat information including name, type, length, and maximum passenger capacity. List amenities like GPS, fish finder, and safety equipment.

list.title: Trip Details
list.description: Create trip packages (e.g., Half Day, Full Day). Set duration, pricing, and target species for each trip type. You can offer multiple trip options.

list.title: Availability
list.description: Set your operating days and hours. Mark seasonal availability and any dates you're unavailable. Anglers will only see open slots.

list.title: Policies
list.description: Define your cancellation policy, weather policy, what guests should bring, and any additional rules. Clear policies build trust with customers.

list.title: Media Upload
list.description: Upload at least 3 photos (up to 20) of your charter and boat. Add up to 5 short videos (max 30 seconds each). Select your cover photo.

list.title: Contact & Verification
list.description: Confirm your phone number and email. Optionally upload your captain license for verified status badge.

list.title: Review & Submit
list.description: Preview your complete listing. Review all details and submit for approval. Once approved, you'll start receiving booking requests!

list.title: Use High-Quality Photos
list.description: Bright, clear photos of your boat, catches, and happy customers attract more bookings. Minimum 800x600 pixels recommended.

list.title: Write a Detailed Description
list.description: Tell your story! Mention your experience, specialty, and what makes your charter unique. Aim for at least 50 words.

list.title: Set Competitive Pricing
list.description: Research similar charters in your area. Offer value through included gear, refreshments, or fishing expertise.

list.title: Keep Availability Updated
list.description: Regularly update your calendar to avoid double bookings. Mark unavailable dates as soon as you know them.

list.title: Respond Quickly
list.description: Fast responses to booking requests lead to higher conversion rates. Enable notifications to never miss a request.

compliance.title: Safety & Compliance
compliance.description: Your safety and data protection are paramount. Fishon.my operates under strict compliance standards.
legal: Made by Malaysians, for Malaysian anglers and captains.

items.q: Do I need to pay to join?
items.a: No. It's 100% free to list your charter. We only take a commission 10% of the trip price on successful bookings.

We verify captains to build trust. You'll need: Maritime license/Seafarer ID (where applicable), boat registration certificate, vessel/public liability insurance, and first aid certification. This typically takes 3-5 business days.

Customers reach you directly via chat, phone, or email—your choice. You manage communications directly without platform intermediaries. Full details on booking and cancellation policies are available in our Refund & Cancellation Policy.

items.q: Can I manage my availability and bookings?
items.a: Yes. Our platform lets you manage your availability and bookings. For detailed information on rescheduling and cancellations, check our Refund & Cancellation Policy and Terms of Service.

items.q: How do you protect my data?
items.a: We take data security seriously. All personal information is protected under Malaysia's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA). See our Privacy Policy for complete details on how we collect, use, and safeguard your data.
